topic: Data Quality and Signal Loss in B2B Marketing
headline: 96% of B2B marketers use AI, but hiring is moving toward judgment and QA roles
keyNotes: A surprising 96% of businesses that sell to other businesses (known as B2B marketers) are now using artificial intelligence (AI) in their daily tasks.
Even with widespread AI use, companies are increasingly looking to hire people for jobs that require human judgment, meaning the ability to make smart decisions.
They are also seeking roles focused on quality assurance (QA), which involves carefully checking work to make sure it's correct and meets standards.
This shift in hiring shows that while technology handles many tasks, uniquely human skills like critical thinking and ensuring accuracy are becoming even more valuable.
question: Considering that even with 96% of marketers using AI, companies are prioritizing human judgment and quality control (QA) in hiring, how might you focus on developing or highlighting these uniquely human skills in your own professional role?
